scripts.//check:build: The bundle esbuild produces for workerd resolves packages under different conditions than tsx does, so tsc passing is not evidence the worker deploys. Run this before trusting any green check.
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:build && npm run check:units
scripts.//check:units: db-flows needs a Postgres and skips loudly without one; see the header of db-flows-check.ts.
scripts.check:units: for c in security audit burn escrow mint auth-parity openapi searchnftbyasset searchnftbyowner nfts-price admin-range chains stripe web3fees mintjob flags db-flows payment-flows; do echo "--- $c ---"; tsx "$c-check.ts" || exit 1; done
scripts.//test:devnet: Mints for real on devnet: needs a local Postgres and either a working faucet or a funded ~/.config/solana/id.json. Skips loudly without them. Run before a deploy, not on every save.
